item.title: Mailday 0.1.48 · build 50
item.description: Inbox sections now show three messages with Collapse, View all and Show less, while preserving Mailday controls and card backgrounds. Attachments use compact standalone icons or local thumbnails; real download progress fills the stationary icon, with Cancel, Retry and Open. Auto-download attachments now controls separate Gmail and IMAP file downloads. Small files already supplied by Gmail remain available. Cloud login remains disabled; closed-app push is unchanged. Preserves sender and reply headers for attachment-only messages and repairs affected cached records.
